Tween-Chelex extraction, followed by McrBC digestion, sWGA amplification using 6A-10AD primers and sequencing on a HiSeq platform is a cost-effective, reliable method for sequencing low density P. falciparum DNA from DBS samples.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to obtain whole-genome sequence data from DBS with low parasitemia using a combination of DNA extraction and amplification methods.
it is important to optimize the extraction and amplification protocols for each new set of samples to ensure the highest quality data.
the quality of WGS data is not only a function of the number of parasites present in a given sample, but also a function of the method of extraction and the downstream processing.
